description: This source file contains extension methods for configuring and adding an Azure Table Grain Directory within the Orleans hosting silo builder. It provides methods to set up the grain directory with default options or custom configurations.

classes.name: AzureTableGrainDirectorySiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to facilitate configuration of Azure Table Grain Directory.

methods.name: UseAzureTableGrainDirectoryAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to use Azure Table Grain Directory as the default grain directory with specified options.

methods.name: AddAzureTableGrainDirectory
methods.description: Adds an Azure Table Grain Directory with a specified name and configuration to the silo builder.
